scope: Champion enrichment batch 10H: last five of 40 source-linked, independently written fight-decision profiles; this is editorial advice, not claimed live gameplay testing.

decisions.title: Build Poise with real Dexterity opportunities
decisions.text: Stark Enhanced Spider-Man can gain Poise by correctly dodging attacks with Dexterity. Choose a familiar Special or basic animation before chasing the resource; intentionally taking a hit to gain stacks is not worthwhile.

decisions.title: Use SP1 Stun only with the required Stark AI condition
decisions.text: SP1 can supply a strong Stun opening while Stark AI is active, but the state and Stun immunity both matter. Check the indicator and confirm the Stun before committing to another attack sequence.

decisions.title: Choose SP2 Shock or emergency Heavy Power Drain by threat
decisions.text: SP2 can deliver Shock damage while an eligible Heavy can help control power. Against a Shock-immune or dangerous power-gaining defender, evaluate which utility keeps the fight safe rather than always maximizing Poise first.

decisions.title: Progress the correct challenges before promising full Camo utility
decisions.text: Miles can develop different challenges using well-timed blocks, intercepts and dodged attacks. Check each current objective rather than treating every combo as progress; the full Special-triggered Camo plan depends on completing them.

decisions.title: Bait a manageable Special to enter Camo
decisions.text: Opponent Specials can trigger Camo, opening an opportunity for a Heavy Taunt and Rupture plan. Check the opponent's anti-Miss or True Strike and available space, since Camo is not blanket immunity to the next attack.

decisions.title: Spend SP2 only with a developed personal-debuff mix
decisions.text: SP2 can benefit from Camo and several applied personal debuffs, while SP1 offers Weakness utility. Against Rupture-resistant or cleansing defenders, a shorter control route can be safer than holding two bars for a weakened burst.

decisions.title: Build web seals through reliable knockdowns and SP1
decisions.text: Pavitr can create stage webs and seals from eligible knockdowns and SP1. Track where the opponent lands and how many seals are active rather than launching a Special as though the maximum setup is already complete.

decisions.title: Create vulnerability only from the permitted movement trigger
decisions.text: An eligible dodge or opponent dash can help make Energy Vulnerability part of the following Special sequence. Check the state and defender's Energy resistance instead of inventing a permanent debuff application from every attack.

decisions.title: Spend SP2 during an established seal and Fury window
decisions.text: SP2 can deliver stronger damage after enough seals and supporting offensive buffs have been developed. SP3 offers a different longer-fight Neutralize and recovery approach; choose based on target buffs and remaining fight duration.

decisions.title: Select the cartridge that counters the actual defender
decisions.text: Stealth Suit Spider-Man can choose Web-Foam Slow, Tranquilizer Enervate or Flash Bang Fragility. Set the pre-fight option for the target's mechanic, because a wrong cartridge cannot be swapped for free mid-quest.

decisions.title: Apply cartridges through the correct Light or SP2 input
decisions.text: A fourth Light hit or SP2 can use the loaded cartridge while Spider-Sense shapes the rotation. Watch remaining ammunition and active effects; a zero-cartridge sequence cannot provide the same counter utility.

decisions.title: Keep Fury and Precision active with deliberate dash timing
decisions.text: Replacing an existing cartridge effect can create Fury, while dash-back can pause certain personal buffs. Check their timers and use a safe spacing opportunity; SP3 may be worthwhile only when the reload cost is justified.

decisions.title: Maintain Reflex buffs with the correct Light hit
decisions.text: Symbiote Spider-Man can use third-Light attacks to develop and refresh Reflex-related buffs. Count the sequence rather than repeating generic five-hit combos that may miss the intended trigger.

decisions.title: Use Heavy Armor Break before the desired Special buff
decisions.text: A safe Heavy can prepare Armor Break for a following SP1 Cruelty or SP2 Precision setup. Armor Break immunity or a dangerous Heavy punish makes this rotation weaker, so consider a direct Special instead.

decisions.title: Treat post-Special Evade as a timed resource
decisions.text: A Special can create an Evade opportunity that supports further Armor Break in the right circumstances, while SP3 can reward a longer build. Check enemy anti-Evade effects before relying on it to protect a risky follow-up.
